fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: User-provided description for this network peering.

fields.label: Export Custom Routes
fields.help: True if custom routes are exported to the peered network; false otherwise.

fields.label: Export Custom Routes With Public IP
fields.help: True if all subnet routes with a public IP address range are exported; false otherwise.

fields.label: Import Custom Routes
fields.help: True if custom routes are imported from the peered network; false otherwise.

fields.label: Import Custom Routes With Public IP
fields.help: True if custom routes are imported from the peered network; false otherwise.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The ID of the Network Peering.

fields.label: Peer Network
fields.help: The relative resource name of the network to peer with a standard VMware Engine network.

fields.label: Peer Network Type
fields.help: The type of the network to peer with the VMware Engine network.

fields.label: Vmware Engine Network
fields.help: The relative resource name of the VMware Engine network.
